conflicts.fact: What nutrient sukuma wiki provides / which food contains fats
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 says the sukuma wiki's fats are handled by different enzymes (treating sukuma wiki as the fat source). Lesson 1 and Lesson 6 describe sukuma wiki as fibre and vitamins, with fat coming from nyama choma or cooking oil. Lesson 5 shows sukuma wiki giving only a faint emulsion and the cooking fat as the fat source.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson's food tests cover which foods, and whether sukuma wiki and the bean/nyama samples were tested for starch and sugars
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 lists five samples (cooked ugali, raw maize flour, banana, sukuma wiki extract, glucose). Lesson 5 says that in the preceding lesson learners confirmed starch and reducing sugars in 'ugali and sukuma wiki'. Lesson 4 found sukuma wiki weak or negative for both tests.

conflicts.fact: Number of samples in Lesson 5 and where the Lesson 4 sample set comes from
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 overview and Predict say 'five test substances' but list six (nyama choma, bean broth, milk, butter, oil, sukuma wiki). Lesson 4 says 'five food samples' but names ugali cooked, raw maize flour, banana, sukuma wiki, glucose, and calls them all drawn from the meal, though banana and glucose are not part of it.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson the 'next lesson' fat/protein tests and the 3D model are placed in; reference to lessons in model-building continuity
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says the Food Journey Map will be revised at the end of Lessons 3, 5, and 8. Lessons 2, 3, 5, 6 revise the model every lesson, and Lesson 4 has no model revision. Lesson 8 compares the Lesson 1 map with the Lesson 7 model.
Lesson 3 gives pepsin and rennin as stomach enzymes. Lessons 2, 5, 6, 7 and 8 mention only pepsin (with HCl), and Lesson 8 lists no rennin.

conflicts.fact: Number of Benedict test steps and what Lesson 8 says about earlier lessons
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8 teacher says the four-step procedure is known 'from Lessons 4 and 5', but Lesson 5 covers the Biuret and ethanol emulsion tests, not Benedict's.

conflicts.fact: Number of lessons / which lessons are described as past
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8 says 'over the course of seven lessons' and also 'eight lessons investigating one question'. Lesson 3 calls the sequence 'eight-lesson evidence-gathering'.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson addresses how the stomach avoids digesting itself
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 says the self-digestion question will be revisited in Lesson 5. Lesson 5 only raises it as a new question, and Lesson 6 is where it is answered.

Lesson 3 says specific enzymes are made by specific glands and secreted at specific locations. Lesson 6 says sphincters explain how the body 'knows' when to move food. Lesson 7 says cells are genetically programmed to secrete enzymes in response to stimuli. Lesson 8 says hormonal and neural signals trigger secretion.
